svg.aria-label: Step 1, recon: /pya types into a terminal while the three bots walk a blueprint of the app. Entry points from the internet light up until 14 are found, 4 trust boundaries draw in around the database, secrets and an external API, and the six STRIDE threat tiles flip on. The context is packed and one envelope flies to each of the 9 security agents.
